overview.description: The WisdomTree Bloomberg US Dollar Bullish Fund (USDU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long usd, short global basket currency. The fund is an actively managed ETF that goes long the US dollar against a basket of global currencies from developed as well as emerging markets. USDU was launched on Dec 18, 2013 and is issued by WisdomTree.
